offence_note: Two counts of assault and criminal harassment of nursing home residents
sentence_quote: we dismiss the appeal against conviction, grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal against sentence and impose sentence in accordance with the joint submission.
note: Joint submission of 8-month conditional sentence plus 1 year probation restored; judge had imposed intermittent sentence.

offence_note: Possession of one kilogram of cocaine for trafficking
sentence_quote: I would set aside the CSO and probation order and substitute a conventional jail sentence of three years.
note: Crown appeal; four months served on the CSO credited without remission.

offence_note: Kidnapping and accessory after the fact to murder
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced Daniel to four years’ incarceration for kidnapping and three years’ incarceration consecutive for being an accessory after-the-fact to murder.
note: Only Daniel's sentence appeal reviewed; brother Shawntez's murder sentence not shown (conviction appeal only).

offence_note: Drug trafficking, loaded firearm offences, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: We therefore deny the conviction appeal, grant leave to appeal sentence, and allow the sentence appeal in part by reducing the sentence on count 1 from 2 years to 18 months. This reduces the net sentence from 10.5 years to 10 years.
systemic_quote: The mitigating circumstances included the anti-Black racism he had experienced; the trial judge found there was a link between the offences and the disadvantage described in the presentence report
note: Global 14 years reduced by 6 months (computed 13y 6m); net 10 years after credit.

offence_note: Firearm, cocaine and drug possession, proceeds, death threat, brass knuckles
sentence_quote: I would set aside the conditional sentence and impose a sentence of 120 days of presentence custody, to be credited at 180 days, plus two years’ probation on the same terms as previously set out.
note: Global 2 years less a day unchanged; only made legal by reallocating presentence custody; Crown appeal.

offence_note: Receiving material benefit from commission of an offence (s. 286.2)
sentence_quote: we grant the appellant leave to appeal his sentence, but dismiss the appeal against the sentence.
note: Quebec pre-sentence custody credit not applicable to Ontario offence.

offence_note: Offences not identified; counts 1 and 3 of a group attack
sentence_quote: the sentence on count #1 is reduced to twelve months imprisonment and on count #3 to twelve months imprisonment consecutive for a total sentence of twenty-four months imprisonment
note: Offences not named; sentence reduced for disparity with co-accused; credit 24 months for 12 months pre-trial custody.

offence_note: Firearms offences including loaded restricted handgun
sentence_quote: The appellant received a six-year global sentence less 18 months pre-sentence custody credited at 1.5:1, leaving three years and nine months remaining to be served.
note: Credit 27 months computed from 18 months at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Procuring a 14-year-old to become a prostitute
sentence_quote: She was sentenced to 18 months’ imprisonment.
note: Court says judge took account of youthful first offender.

sentence_quote: Mr. Perrin, you are sentenced to 30 days to be served at the Central Nova Scotia Correctional Facility on an intermittent basis
note: 10-year prohibition on owning animals; 30 days served intermittently on weekends.

offence_note: Manslaughter of boyfriend in hotel room
sentence_quote: Ms. Stetski will therefore be sentenced to three years imprisonment taking account of the year and a half she has spent in custody.
note: Six years reduced by three years for 18 months pre-trial custody at 2:1.
